text:
Morgan: Heads up — saw a ~4x spike in leads from the 'Benchmark 2026' paid carousel between 10:00-12:00 PT. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dash/pulseboard?range=last24h :eyes:
Ravi: Looking... GA4 shows most as 'direct' not last-click. Likely UTM drop.
Sam: We had a quick promo push + partner crosspost at 10:05, but creative was same. campaign id: benchmark_q2_carousel
Elena: Also pushed a new landing headline at 09:58 (A/B var B). Could be conversion lift.
Ravi: quick query I'm running:
```
SELECT utm_source, COUNT(*) as leads FROM events.leads WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-21T09:30:00Z' AND '2026-03-21T12:30:00Z' GROUP BY utm_source;
```
Ravi: preliminary: 78% utm_source=NULL, 12% ad_network, 10% partner
Yara: Sales ops seeing many leads tagged with partner 'Orbit' in SFDC? Might be API mapping mismatch.
Marcos: FYI our referral webhook had a retry window at 09:59; we rotated a token earlier today.
OpsBot: Deploy finished: marketing-landing v2 at 09:58 by @elena
Morgan: If attribution is broken we can't trust weekly KPI. Need mitigation: fallback tag + run re-attribution job?
Ravi: I can backfill utm from click logs if clicks exist. ETA ~2h.
Sam: I'll pause the paid creative to avoid polluting further until we confirm.
Elena: Reverting headline live now.
Yara: I'll flag to AE team to hold outreach for these leads and add a note on lead quality.
Morgan: Can we have a short summary block for tomorrow's KPI meeting? 1) what happened 2) impact (est leads) 3) fix + next steps
Ravi: I'll post results and a CSV in #marketing in ~2.5h
Sam: Thanks. :thumbsup:
Marcos: Noted for postmortem if >100 leads.
Morgan: Cheers everyone.
